Portfolio

Senegal-native Maty Fall sent her portfolio to IMG Models in 2019 and was quickly whisked away to Paris only a few months later, debuting on the runway for St. Laurent and closing for Valentino in her first season. In the years since, she has walked for Chanel, Dior, Victoria’s Secret, Versace, Fendi, Max Mara, Alberta Ferretti, and Ferragamo. She’s appeared in campaigns for Burberry, Prada, and Etro. With her striking features and multilingual background––she can speak the Senegalese language Wolof as well as French, Italian, and in a pinch Spanish, to name a few––it seems Fall was born to be an international model. She has worked with photographers such as Steven Meisel, Alasdair McLellan, Paolo Roversi, and Dario Catellani. She has has also appeared on the cover of Vogue Italia and in publications such as Purple, Vogue, Vogue France, i-D, V, Dior Magazine, and Self-Service. Fall was also a 2024 Models.com “Model of the Year” nominee.
